title: A 30-mile perfectly straight edge on Mars

tellings.quote: is a non natural Edge you don't get a 30 mile Edge like that W by Nature

plain: Negatives from Mars mapping by NASA's Jet Propulsion Laboratory show a perfectly straight edge about 30 miles long on the planet's surface, according to the remote viewer Joe McMoneagle. He says he saw it himself and that "you don't get a 30 mile edge like that" by nature, which he takes as a sign that something on Mars was built.
